stories.title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
stories.body: Ukraine says the missile and drone attack on the strategic bridge in the Russian-annexed Crimea took weeks to plan.

stories.title: How the attack on Crimean Bridge unfolded
stories.body: One of the key symbols of Russia's occupation of Ukraine has suffered major damage after a seven-stage attack by Kyiv.

stories.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results
stories.body: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.

stories.title: Thomas Markle charged over child sex abuse material in Philippines
stories.body: Markle is being held in custody in the US after one charge and has previously denied all of the allegations.

stories.title: 'It was really scary': Mother describes sheltering during Russia strikes on Kyiv bridge
stories.body: Moscow has targeted bridges in Kyiv, while Ukraine severely damaged a critical bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea.

stories.title: Russian military plane crashes, killing all 19 on board
stories.body: Russia's defence ministry says it preliminarily believes a technical malfunction was the cause of the crash in the Kemerovo region.

stories.title: Palestinian woman, 72, shot dead by Israeli settlers in West Bank, health ministry says
stories.body: Palestinians say there was an attack by settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, while the Israeli military says the settlers fired after being attacked.

stories.title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers
stories.body: States have reported over 5,400 cases and 10 measles-related deaths for the first time since the early 1990s.

stories.title: American soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying taken into US military custody
stories.body: The Metropolitan Police say he has been taken into custody by the US Military over suspected national security and espionage allegations.

stories.title: William and Kate celebrate Earthshot Prize winners in Mumbai
stories.body: The Prince and Princess of Wales were joined by sporting and acting stars for the annual environmental awards ceremony.

stories.title: Trump in Asia ahead of talks with Russian and Chinese presidents
stories.body: The US president said he would be open to a one-on-one meeting with Russia's Vladimir Putin "if it's available".

stories.title: Indian woman gang-raped while pregnant in 2002 'heartbroken' after two perpetrators bailed
stories.body: Bilkis Bano has spoken of her "pain, shock and disbelief" at the top court order and vowed to fight back.

stories.title: Nvidia partner Megaspeed being investigated by US government over chip exports
stories.body: The Singapore-based company is suspected of helping to ship high-end AI chips from tech giant Nvidia to China, violating US export rules.

stories.title: Trump says US taking 'very seriously' any Iranian plot against Washington
stories.body: Tehran rejects any suggestion it was plotting a so-called dirty bomb attack on the US capital as "baseless".

stories.title: UK sanctions firms over Israeli West Bank settlements
stories.body: It marks the first sanctions since the UK announced a tougher approach to Israeli actions in the territory.

stories.title: Carney looks to China as Trump tariffs squeeze Canada's car industry
stories.body: The PM has suggested Chinese automakers could replace American ones in Canada - but some say that would not be easy.

stories.title: Gunmen kill Costa Rican journalist who reported on drugs trade
stories.body: Rodríguez had denounced alleged links between criminal organisations and powerful figures in Costa Rica.

stories.title: BBC reports from Kyiv bridge hit by Russian attack
stories.body: The BBC's Sarah Rainsford spoke to residents near the site of the overnight strike.

stories.title: Inside the Chinese 'AI wonderland' where Xi will host Trump
stories.body: The meeting will take place as Trump attends the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation (Apec) summit in the southern city of Shenzhen.

stories.title: Will President Trump meet Kim Jong Un?
stories.body: President Trump says he would be keen to meet the North Korea leader in China.
